page_title: RMA 3-0 CAD | Real Madrid v Cadiz CF 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' 3 - 0 Goal! Nacho Fernandez puts the ball across the area and Joselu (Real Madrid) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 3:0.
90+3' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Conan Ledesma.
90+2' Joselu (Real Madrid) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it!
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the left side of the goal. Conan Ledesma is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
89' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Iglesias Villanueva no option but to blow his whistle.
89' The current number of shots on goal is 6:1.
85' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' Substitution. Robert Navarro makes his way off the pitch and Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) comes on as his replacement.
83' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
83' The attendance is 72654.
82' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
80' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Eduardo Camavinga will be replaced by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid).

80' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
78' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
75' It's time for a substitution. Juanmi (Cadiz) comes on in place of Chris Ramos.
75' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to make a change. Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) replaces Ruben Sobrino.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Brahim Diaz can be given a rest.
73' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.

68' 2 - 0 Goal Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid)! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) was put through by Brahim Diaz and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
66' Here is a change. Alex Fernandez is going off and Mauricio Pellegrino gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Pires (Cadiz).
66' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to substitute Joseba Zaldua and he is replaced by Iza Carcelen (Cadiz).
66' Here comes a substitution. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Arda Guler.
64' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

63' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Javier Iglesias Villanueva stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. That's a free kick to Real Madrid.
61' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
60' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

59' Joselu (Real Madrid) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Joselu (Real Madrid) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cadiz CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' Victor Chust (Cadiz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Real Madrid are awarded the free kick.
54' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight and sees a foul from Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
51' 1 - 0 Goal! Luka Modric provides Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the top right corner. 1:0.
49' A corner kick by Real Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Conan Ledesma (Cadiz).
48' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
48' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) commits a rough foul. Javier Iglesias Villanueva stops the game and makes a call. Real Madrid have a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Madrid.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' What a miss! The corner finds Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
45' Cadiz CF will take a corner kick.
44' Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
39' Real Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' Today's referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva rightly decides to book Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz) for his harsh tackle.
38' Chance! Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
37' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Conan Ledesma intercepts the ball.
36' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
34' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
33' Cadiz CF have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
33' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. Cadiz CF have a corner.

32' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

31' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. It's a free kick to Real Madrid, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cadiz CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Cadiz CF.
25' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

23' Ambitious effort from Chris Ramos (Cadiz). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
19' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
16' Real Madrid hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
12' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Conan Ledesma is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
9' Fali (Cadiz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
7' Looks like Fali (Cadiz) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
7' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
7' Real Madrid decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Madrid.
3' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Real Madrid will kick the game off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
